# GitHub OAuth Harvester — LLM Specification

> Machine-readable context file for AI Agents operating the GitHub OAuth Harvester suite.

## Capabilities
- RFC-5322 Email aliasing engine (`dot_trick`, `plus_addressing`).
- SSL IMAP real-time listener for GitHub 8-digit OTP extraction.
- Modular OAuth adapters for CodeBuddy Global, GoRouter, and Tabi AI.
- Additive SQLite ingestion into 9Router local AI gateway.

## Command Interface
- `python3 main.py generate --user <username> --domain <domain> --type <dot|plus> --count <N> --json`
- `python3 main.py listen-otp --user <email> --password <16_digit_app_password> --timeout <seconds> --json`
- `python3 main.py inject --platform <codebuddy|gorouter|tabiai> --token <token_str> --json`

## Platform Schema
- `tabiai`: USD Balance ($120 Welcome + $5-$10 Daily Check-in)
- `gorouter`: USD Balance ($70 Welcome + $5-$10 Daily Check-in)
- `codebuddy`: Usage Credits (250 Bonus + 100 Monthly Credits)
